title: Glowing red metal found in a yard under a UFO

tellings.quote: world, but he called me and he drives up in his yard and there's this red piece of glowing he sees this thing over his house and it goes away when he drives up, but there's a piece of red glowing metal in the yard.

plain: Some time in the 1990s in Zanesville, Ohio, a man saw something hovering over his house that went away as he drove up, and he found a piece of glowing red metal in his yard. A man named Chris Bledsoe, the subject of an episode about a man said to attract UFOs, says the man called him about it, and he passes it on second-hand without naming him. If true, it would mean the craft left something solid behind.
